features: Inputs: 8 BNC (AHD/analog) + 4 IP; up to 12 IP channels (up to 12 channels mixed analog + IP)
Analog input: 960H analog cameras and 720p/1080p/4K AHD cameras; recording up to 4K (3840x2160)
IP recording bandwidth 24-72 Mbps (24 Mbps default, about +6 Mbps per disabled analog channel)
Coax-channel analytics: PID / LCD / sound detection / camera tampering

Intelligent video analysis on IP channels (depending on IP camera model): perimeter intrusion detection (PID), line crossing detection (LCD), stationary object detection (SOD), pedestrian detection (PD), face detection, cross counting (CC), sound detection, camera tampering
8 alarm inputs, 1 alarm output; 8 audio inputs, 1 audio output (RCA)
Power consumption not recorded: urmet.de states 15 W without HDD, the user manual and urmet.com state 15.5 W (11 W without HDD)
Power supply not recorded: urmet.de states 12 V DC 5 A, urmet.com states 12 V / 2 A
Ethernet speed not recorded: urmet.de states 10/100 Mbps, urmet.com states 100/1000 Mbps
Operating temperature not recorded: urmet.de states -10 to +55 C, the user manual and urmet.com state 0 to +40 C
Dimensions and weight not recorded: urmet.de lists 380 x 50 x 340 mm, approx. 4 kg; urmet.com lists 300 x 53 x 227 mm, approx. 3 kg; datasheet product data lists 222 x 300 x 50 mm, 1.758 kg
Named in Urmet S.p.A. NDAA Section 889 statement (main chipset), June 2023
